presence_rationale: Dedicated 'Financial education programs' and 'Supporting customers in need of extra care' sections, plus dedicated First Nations Customer Support, accessibility and language support coverage. Topic comprehensively addressed.
specificity_rationale: Multiple named programmes (MoneyMinded across 17 markets, MoneyMinded for Family Violence, MoneyBusiness for Indigenous Australians, Saver Plus matched savings up to $500), partnerships (Berry Street since 2016 for Family Violence training), First Nations Customer Support Line, ATM multilingual options (12 languages), iSign interpreter service, Financial Wellbeing Assist (Hardship) team. Substantive operational detail.
quantification_rationale: Reports the SASB FN-CB-240a.4 metric: 118,021 MoneyMinded participants this year (>1 million cumulative since 2002), 22,617 across Asia/Pacific/NZ, 440+ Family Violence Coaches accredited, 400+ scams-module coaches trained since March 2024. Hardship metrics: ~4 in 1000 home loan customers, ~2 in 1000 small business; 4,021 NZ hardship customers (+37% YoY). SASB 240a.1/.2/.3 (small business loans, no-cost accounts) not in retrieved evidence.
